arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

origin.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
origin.example:
parsed <- spec_table(I("x y\n1 a"))
paste(vapply(parsed$cols, function(col) class(col)[1], ""), collapse = ",")

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The data, path, or collector this function accepts.

translation.value: The same value readr 2.2.0 returns for this case, written as one line in the output.
translation.example:
parsed = spec_table(I("x y\n1 a"))
return ",".join("collector_" + collector.kind for collector in parsed.cols)
